text:
maria: CI image push failing for PR #7890, buildkite job 412 shows registry error during push, can someone take a quick look?

maria: log: "Pushing layers... error: received unexpected HTTP status: 409 Conflict - blob upload state mismatch (writelock)"

kenji: saw a few of these overnight, likely concurrent cleanup job locking blobs on registry. Which registry? internal-registry.redwood.svc

maria: it's internal-registry in prod-eu. full error:
```
failed to upload blob: unexpected EOF while reading chunk 5 of 7
http status 409: blob upload invalid: writelock active
```

registry-bot: [auto] Notified #registry-admins; ticket created REG-2342 (see: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REG-2342)

james: can you try `docker buildx build --no-cache` locally and push to a personal tag? could be cache-corrupt on builder

maria: trying now, will report back

maria: local push succeeded -> so CI builder instance is suspect. It uses buildkit cache from s3-backed cache

liam: suggested fix: force new builder in CI `docker buildx create --use --name ci-${BUILDKIT_ID}` and add `--no-cache` as a fallback if push fails

maria: kicked a rerun with new builder flag, job 413

registry-admin: checked registry logs, saw overlapping uploads from 10.128.4.22 at 03:12 UTC. We saw a stale lock on /blobs/sha256/abcd... that blocked the finalization. Cleared lock manually. Recommend adding retries with exponential backoff in push step. Also our GC/cleanup job rotated locks at 03:10 which likely raced with CI uploads.

kenji: I'll add a small change to the buildkite template to 1) create ephemeral builder per job, 2) retry push up to 3 times with backoff, and 3) invalidate cache if base image changed. Will link PR in a minute.

maria: thanks all — rerun passed. I'll add notes to PR and link REG-2342.

maria: resolution: CI buildkit cache raced with registry cleanup -> mitigated by clearing lock + forcing ephemeral builder + adding retries. Logging ticket REG-2342 and PR #7902 updated with changes. :thumbsup:
